text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, bleomycin sulfate is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 12 vials at 3.9 vials per day, providing 3.1 days of supply. Corvale General holds 67 vials at 3 vials per day, providing 22.7 days of supply. Corvale Lakeside holds 16 vials at 0.9 vials per day, providing 18.5 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include bleomycin sulfate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new purchasing. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer while maintaining adequate supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 25 vials of bleomycin sulfate 15 USP units from Corvale General to Corvale East. Requires approval by the pharmacy director via transfer request.
2. If the first transfer cannot be executed, transfer 3 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Requires approval by the pharmacy director via transfer request.
3. If transfers are not feasible, the buyer may purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., or Hospira, Inc. Requires approval by the buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
